stories.label: Iran war: 2,000 targets hit, B-52s deployed, 'double Iraq' scale
stories.summary: Operation Epic Fury Day 4: 2,000 targets hit, B-52 strategic bombers deployed. CENTCOM commander says operation is 'double the scale' of 2003 Iraq invasion. Iran retaliating — missile hit Al-Udeid base in Qatar, drone fire near US consulate in Dubai. Russia and China raising diplomatic voices. Congress moving on war powers. Mass funeral held for 165 schoolgirls.

stories.label: War economic fallout: Hormuz traffic at zero, KOSPI circuit breaker, global markets in freefall
stories.summary: Hormuz marine traffic now at zero — normally 50+ ships over 100m transiting. KOSPI circuit breaker triggered after 8% crash; trading halted for 20 minutes. Won still past 1,500/dollar. Trump says Navy could escort tankers 'if necessary.' Central banks constrained by energy-driven inflation. BOK warns of 'excessive FX volatility diverging from fundamentals.'

stories.label: Lebanon: Full ground invasion, Baalbek struck, Hezbollah declares 'open war'
stories.summary: Israel sent ground troops into southern Lebanon. 80+ villages ordered to evacuate (16 more today). Baalbek struck. Hezbollah declared 'open war.' 58,000+ displaced. Macron deployed aircraft carrier to Mediterranean, warned Israel. Syria still has troops on Lebanon border.

stories.label: US Congress moves on war powers after senators fear 'boots on the ground'
stories.summary: Senate war powers resolution by Tim Kaine invokes 1973 WPR. Two competing House measures. Democratic senators came out of classified briefing fearing ground invasion. Congress debating constraints while 2,000 targets already hit.

stories.label: Nepal votes March 5 — first election since Gen Z protests toppled government
stories.summary: Election Thursday March 5. Youth-led protests last September killed 77, forced PM out. New protest-born parties vs. old guard. AI deepfakes targeting young voters.

stories.label: Khamenei succession: burial in Mashhad, Assembly of Experts building bombed
stories.summary: Khamenei to be buried in Mashhad (his birthplace) at Imam Reza shrine. Farewell ceremony in Tehran first. Assembly of Experts building in Qom was bombed during succession vote. Interim leadership council still scrambling.

stories.label: Pakistan triple crisis: Karachi shootings, visa suspension, border war
stories.summary: US Marines opened fire on Pakistani protesters at Karachi consulate. At least 10 killed. Visas suspended. Dawn editorial 'Burning questions' demands inquiry into who authorized lethal force. Pakistan invoked Saudi defense pact to deter Iran strikes on its territory.

stories.label: Sudan: War grinds on while world watches Iran
stories.summary: RSF drone strike knocked out El-Obeid power grid. War continues with zero global diplomatic attention as Iran consumes everything. UK court lawsuits against RSF/UAE leaders still pending.

stories.label: Russian strikes at 3-year peak — Iran war diverts global attention
stories.summary: 288 missiles in February — 3-year high. Zelensky fears Iran war will hurt Ukraine. Russia escalating while global attention diverted.

stories.label: Gaza sealed: crossings closed, Al-Aqsa shut, aid halted — 5 cycles uncovered
stories.summary: Total siege continues. All crossings sealed. 37 aid orgs halted. Al-Aqsa shut during Ramadan. Iran war providing cover. Five cycles without dedicated coverage — the silence itself is newsworthy. No fresh story in today's feed to anchor coverage.

stories.label: 1.1 million Filipino overseas workers at risk across 5 Middle East countries
stories.summary: 1.1M Filipino OFWs — mostly women in domestic work — trapped across five war-affected countries. Duterte allies using Iran war to attack Philippines' US ties.

stories.label: Milei's legislative blitz: labour reform, criminal age lowered, glacier law weakened
stories.summary: Labour reform passed, criminal age lowered to 14, glacier protections weakened. VP Villarruel says Milei govt wants her to resign.

stories.label: British lawyers to sue UAE and RSF leaders in UK courts for Sudan war crimes
stories.summary: UK lawyers will file lawsuits in British courts against UAE and RSF leaders for war crimes.

stories.label: OpenAI takes Pentagon deal, AI confirmed used in Iran strikes
stories.summary: OpenAI changed military deal to prohibit spying on Americans after backlash. AI confirmed used in Iran strikes. Anthropic still cut out.

stories.label: Chile's Kast halts transition over Chinese subsea cable intelligence
stories.summary: Far-right president-elect Kast suspended handover over Chinese subsea cable project.

stories.label: CBP used ad-tech data to track phones without warrants
stories.summary: Internal DHS document confirms CBP used ad ecosystem location data to track phones without warrants.

stories.label: Russia to block Telegram in April — 100M+ users affected
stories.summary: Kremlin says decision is 'final.' Last major channel for anti-war organizing and independent news.

stories.label: US opens chip door for Vietnam, locks it on China
stories.summary: Washington lifts export controls on Vietnam. Strategic chip supply chain shift to Southeast Asia.

stories.label: Sun's 'glitches' during quiet periods explained by scientists
stories.summary: Scientists used helioseismology to explain anomalous vibrations ('glitches') in the Sun during phases of low activity, revealing internal dynamics of our star.

stories.label: Lenovo ThinkPads score perfect 10/10 repairability from iFixit
stories.summary: First major laptop line to score 10/10 from iFixit. Every component user-replaceable with standard tools. EU right-to-repair directive driving manufacturer compliance.

stories.label: Meta smart glasses workers can see everything wearers see
stories.summary: Workers processing Meta smart glasses data can see everything wearers see.

stories.label: Motorola partners with GrapheneOS — bootloader unlockable/relockable
stories.summary: Motorola GrapheneOS devices will have bootloader unlockable and relockable. First mainstream manufacturer shipping privacy-focused OS.

stories.label: EU strips AI, chips, quantum from industrial plan countering China
stories.summary: EU's 'made in Europe' tech policy gutted. Europe choosing dependence on US/Chinese tech.

stories.label: Quantum effects found functional in biological proteins
stories.summary: Evidence growing that quantum tunnelling and coherence play functional roles in proteins.

stories.label: Indonesia targets first nuclear power plant by 2032-2034
stories.summary: World's 4th most populous country commits to nuclear energy. Hormuz crisis making energy security urgent.

stories.label: France expands nuclear arsenal, deploys carrier to Mediterranean
stories.summary: France expanding nuclear arsenal. Carrier deployed to Mediterranean, warned Israel against Lebanon invasion.

stories.label: Iran civilian death toll climbing, school strike 180+ killed
stories.summary: Death toll 787+ (Red Crescent). School strike toll 180+. Mass funeral held for 165 schoolgirls. Funeral for 165 children reported today.

stories.label: Most Americans oppose Iran war — Congress war powers debate
stories.summary: Only 25% of Americans approve strikes. New war powers arc now tracks Congressional action.

stories.label: Mass graves in eastern DRC — US sanctions Rwanda's military
stories.summary: US sanctioned Rwanda's army chief. Mass graves near Uvira.

stories.label: FBI using AI as 'game changer' for hacking operations
stories.summary: FBI official called AI a 'game changer' for remote access operations. First official acknowledgment of AI in US law enforcement cyber ops.

stories.label: US government iPhone-hacking toolkit leaked to foreign spies
stories.summary: Coruna toolkit built for US government iPhone exploitation has reached foreign intelligence services and criminal groups.

stories.label: Earth's oldest crystals suggest plate tectonics started 4.4 billion years ago
stories.summary: 4.4-billion-year-old zircon crystals suggest plate tectonics began far earlier than accepted 3-billion-year timeline.

stories.label: 178+ killed in South Sudan's Ruweng — MSF staff missing
stories.summary: Death toll rose to 178. MSF staff missing. UN warns of return to civil war.
